ld-state-st-track: The 1878 county atlas (Snyder, Van Vechten) draws a Race Track as a grey square in the northwest part of section 32 (T27N R9W), with "Garden Park" beside it, about 600 m southwest of this pin; see the Garden Park pin and the 1800s map type.
d-dells-mill: On the 1878 county atlas the mill is marked as DELL CITY, a town plat in capitals that never grew; see the Dell City pin.
